Subject: Heads-up — Samira D'Souza: counteroffer received, 48hr window

Hi Lauren / Karthik —

Quick heads-up on Samira (SWE-ML/Staff track). She received a competing offer this morning and has a firm acceptance window of ~48 hours. Candidate reiterated Redwood is their top choice. Summary below:

- Current Redwood offer (draft): Base $165,000 + RSU 0.5% over 4 yrs + sign-on $15k (standard band)
- Competing offer (Orbital.ai): base $189,750 (≈15% higher) + $35k sign-on, start date in 3 weeks

Candidate is asking if we can bridge the gap on base or sign-on. Hiring manager (Markus) is supportive of making this competitive within reason. We need:
- confirmation of headcount/budget to lock final base
- compensation exception approval (if we go > band) or approval for elevated sign-on

Attached: candidate_comp_proposal.pdf (proposal summary).

Can we prioritize? Samira's deadline is EOB Monday PT (~48 hours). I can do a call with candidate to hold the window if we can get policy direction now.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Reviewed the draft and the competing terms. Quick recommendation (fast path):

- Offer an elevated, one-time sign-on of $30,000 (taxable, paid on first payroll)
- Increase base by 5% (from $165k → $173,250) which stays within the top of band for Staff SWE at Redwood; any >8% requires Exec comp sign-off
- Maintain RSU target; accelerate first-year cliff to help perceived value

Rationale: preserves band discipline while materially reducing Candidate's out-of-pocket delta vs. Orbital.ai. The one-time sign-on is the fastest governance route and typically approved by Comp for offers on this timeframe. Attached comp_approval_form.pdf — please fill headcount owner and sign-off route.

If you want to match Orbital's base outright, we'll need approval from Exec Comp (multi-day). Recommend Monica present the sign-on + 5% base as the firm offer.

Neha Kapoor
Compensation Manager | Redwood Inference
